question: Must this exact fal provider head complete a funded create, SSH/use, destroy, partial-failure cleanup, and zero-residue run before merge, or may maintainers explicitly waive that item-specific gate?
rationale: The patch introduces a new billable create/delete lifecycle, and automation cannot decide whether authenticated read-only access plus a billing-blocked create is enough to accept first-use production risk despite VISION.md's stated proof requirement.

options.title: Require funded lifecycle proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until redacted exact-head evidence demonstrates create, SSH/use, stop/delete, partial-failure cleanup, and empty final inventory.

options.title: Waive the funded gate
options.body: Explicitly accept first-use provider risk and permit merge based on the existing tests, CI, doctor, inventory, and billing-blocked evidence.

options.title: Pause built-in fal support
options.body: Hold or close the PR if the funded validation cost or provider account requirements are not worth carrying in core now.

recommendation.title: Require funded lifecycle proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until redacted exact-head evidence demonstrates create, SSH/use, stop/delete, partial-failure cleanup, and empty final inventory.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest current history for claim-bound provider lifecycle safety and authored the final fal hardening commits.
